WITH bowler_stats AS (
  SELECT
    wicket_taken.bowler_id,
    SUM(wicket_taken.economy_runs) AS total_runs_conceded,
    COUNT(wicket_taken.wicket_id) AS total_wickets
  FROM wicket_taken
  GROUP BY wicket_taken.bowler_id
),
bowling_average AS (
  SELECT
    bowler_id,
    total_runs_conceded * 1.0 / total_wickets AS bowling_avg
  FROM bowler_stats
  WHERE total_wickets > 0
)
SELECT 
  player.player_name,
  bowling_average.bowling_avg
FROM bowling_average
JOIN player ON bowling_average.bowler_id = player.player_id
ORDER BY bowling_average.bowling_avg ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH bowler_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ball_by_ball.bowler AS bowler_id,
    COUNT(*) AS wickets,
    SUM(ball_by_ball.runs_off_bat + ball_by_ball.extra_runs) AS runs_conceded
  FROM wicket_taken
  JOIN ball_by_ball ON wicket_taken.match_id = ball_by_ball.match_id
    AND wicket_taken.over_id = ball_by_ball.over_id
    AND wicket_taken.ball_id = ball_by_ball.ball_id
    AND wicket_taken.innings_no = ball_by_ball.innings_no
  GROUP BY ball_by_ball.bowler
)
SELECT player.player_name, (runs_conceded * 1.0 / wickets) AS bowling_average
FROM bowler_stats
JOIN player ON player.player_id = bowler_stats.bowler_id
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH customer_monthly_balance AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date) AS year_month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_amount > 0 THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_amount < 0 THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawals,
        SUM(txn_amount) AS month_end_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE strftime('%Y', txn_date) = '2020'
    GROUP BY customer_id, year_month
),

month_customer_counts AS (
    SELECT
        year_month,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN month_end_balance > 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS positive_balance_customer_count,
        AVG(month_end_balance) AS avg_balance_all_customers
    FROM customer_monthly_balance
    GROUP BY year_month
),

max_min_months AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT year_month FROM month_customer_counts ORDER BY positive_balance_customer_count DESC LIMIT 1) AS month_highest,
        (SELECT year_month FROM month_customer_counts ORDER BY positive_balance_customer_count ASC LIMIT 1) AS month_lowest
)

SELECT
    mh.month_highest AS month_with_highest_positive_customer_count,
    mmc_high.avg_balance_all_customers AS average_balance_in_highest_month,
    mh.month_lowest AS month_with_lowest_positive_customer_count,
    mmc_low.avg_balance_all_customers AS average_balance_in_lowest_month,
    mmc_high.avg_balance_all_customers - mmc_low.avg_balance_all_customers AS difference_between_averages
FROM max_min_months mh
JOIN month_customer_counts mmc_high ON mh.month_highest = mmc_high.year_month
JOIN month_customer_counts mmc_low ON mh.month_lowest = mmc_low.year_month;

WITH monthly_balances AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    STRFTIME('%Y-%m', txn_date) AS year_month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) AS month_end_balance
  FROM customer_transactions
  WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', txn_date) = '2020'
  GROUP BY customer_id, year_month
),
monthly_positive_counts AS (
  SELECT
    year_month,
    COUNT(*) AS positive_customer_count
  FROM monthly_balances
  WHERE month_end_balance > 0
  GROUP BY year_month
),
max_min_counts AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(positive_customer_count) AS max_count,
    MIN(positive_customer_count) AS min_count
  FROM monthly_positive_counts
),
max_month AS (
  SELECT year_month FROM monthly_positive_counts, max_min_counts
  WHERE positive_customer_count = max_count
  LIMIT 1
),
min_month AS (
  SELECT year_month FROM monthly_positive_counts, max_min_counts
  WHERE positive_customer_count = min_count
  LIMIT 1
),
avg_balances AS (
  SELECT
    year_month,
    AVG(month_end_balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM monthly_balances
  WHERE year_month IN (SELECT year_month FROM max_month UNION SELECT year_month FROM min_month)
  GROUP BY year_month
)
SELECT
  (SELECT year_month FROM max_month) AS max_positive_month,
  (SELECT avg_balance FROM avg_balances WHERE year_month = (SELECT year_month FROM max_month)) AS avg_balance_max_month,
  (SELECT year_month FROM min_month) AS min_positive_month,
  (SELECT avg_balance FROM avg_balances WHERE year_month = (SELECT year_month FROM min_month)) AS avg_balance_min_month,
  (SELECT avg_balance FROM avg_balances WHERE year_month = (SELECT year_month FROM max_month)) -
  (SELECT avg_balance FROM avg_balances WHERE year_month = (SELECT year_month FROM min_month)) AS difference_avg_balance

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT
        legislator_id,
        MIN(start_date) AS first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms
    WHERE start_date BETWEEN '1917-01-01' AND '1999-12-31'
    GROUP BY legislator_id
),
years AS (
    SELECT generate_series(1, 20) AS year_after_start
),
cohort_size AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM cohort
),
retention AS (
    SELECT
        y.year_after_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ct.legislator_id) AS retained_count
    FROM years y
    CROSS JOIN cohort ct
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON ct.legislator_id = lt.legislator_id
    WHERE DATE(lt.start_date) <= DATE(ct.first_term_start, '+' || y.year_after_start || ' years', '-1 day')
      AND DATE(lt.end_date) > DATE(ct.first_term_start, '+' || y.year_after_start || ' years', '-1 day')
    GROUP BY y.year_after_start
)
SELECT
    y.year_after_start,
    COALESCE(r.retained_count, 0) * 1.0 / cs.total AS retention_rate
FROM years y
LEFT JOIN retention r ON y.year_after_start = r.year_after_start
CROSS JOIN cohort_size cs
ORDER BY y.year_after_start;

WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT
        id_bioguide,
        MIN(term_start) AS first_start_date
    FROM
        legislators_terms
    WHERE
        term_start BETWEEN '1917-01-01' AND '1999-12-31'
    GROUP BY
        id_bioguide
),
cohort AS (
    SELECT
        id_bioguide,
        first_start_date
    FROM
        first_terms
),
retention_years AS (
    SELECT
        c.id_bioguide,
        c.first_start_date,
        y.year_num,
        DATE(STRFTIME('%Y', c.first_start_date) || '-12-31', '+' || y.year_num || ' years') AS retention_date
    FROM
        cohort c,
        (SELECT 1 AS year_num UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL
         SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL
         SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15 UNION ALL
         SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20) y
),
retention_check AS (
    SELECT
        ry.year_num,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ry.id_bioguide) AS cohort_size,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM legislators_terms lt
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = ry.id_bioguide
              AND lt.term_start <= ry.retention_date
              AND (lt.term_end IS NULL OR lt.term_end >= ry.retention_date)
        ) THEN ry.id_bioguide END) AS retained_count
    FROM
        retention_years ry
    GROUP BY
        ry.year_num
)
SELECT
    year_num,
    CAST(retained_count AS FLOAT) / cohort_size AS retention_rate
FROM
    retention_check
ORDER BY
    year_num;

  SELECT
    pco.row_id,
    pco.order_id,
    pco.customer_id,
    CASE WHEN pco.pizza_id = 1 THEN 'Meatlovers' ELSE 'Other' END AS pizza_name,
    pco.pizza_id,
    pco.order_time
  FROM pizza_customer_orders pco
),
std_toppings AS (
  SELECT
    pr.pizza_id,
    tt.topping_name
  FROM pizza_recipes pr
  JOIN pizza_toppings tt ON pr.topping_id = tt.topping_id
),
excluded_toppings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    pge.row_id,
    pte.topping_name
  FROM pizza_get_exclusions pge
  JOIN pizza_toppings pte ON pge.topping_id = pte.topping_id
),
extra_toppings AS (
  SELECT 
    pge.row_id,
    pte.topping_name
  FROM pizza_get_extras pge
  JOIN pizza_toppings pte ON pge.topping_id = pte.topping_id
),
all_ingredients AS (
  SELECT
    bo.row_id,
    bo.order_id,
    bo.customer_id,
    bo.pizza_name,
    COALESCE(prst.topping_name, '') AS topping_name,
    'standard' AS source
  FROM base_orders bo
  LEFT JOIN std_toppings prst ON bo.pizza_id = prst.pizza_id
  WHERE bo.pizza_name IS NOT NULL
),
ingredients_excluded_removed AS (
  SELECT
    ai.row_id,
    ai.order_id,
    ai.customer_id,
    ai.pizza_name,
    ai.topping_name
  FROM all_ingredients ai
  LEFT JOIN excluded_toppings et ON ai.row_id = et.row_id AND ai.topping_name = et.topping_name
  WHERE et.topping_name IS NULL AND ai.topping_name != ''
),
ingredients_with_extra AS (
  SELECT
    ier.row_id,
    ier.order_id,
    ier.customer_id,
    ier.pizza_name,
    ier.topping_name
  FROM ingredients_excluded_removed ier
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    xe.row_id,
    xe.row_id AS order_id,
    NULL as customer_id,
    bo.pizza_name,
    xe.topping_name
  FROM extra_toppings xe
  JOIN base_orders bo ON xe.row_id = bo.row_id
),
ingredients_final AS (
  SELECT
    row_id,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    topping_name,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM ingredients_with_extra
  GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, topping_name
),
ingredients_ordered AS (
  SELECT
    row_id,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    CASE 
      WHEN cnt > 1 THEN '2x' || topping_name 
      ELSE topping_name 
    END AS topping_name_display,
    cnt
  FROM ingredients_final
),
ingredients_sorted AS (
  SELECT
    row_id,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    topping_name_display,
    cnt
  FROM ingredients_ordered
),
ingredients_agg AS (
  SELECT
    row_id,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    -- first list toppings with count>1 in alphabetical order, then single-count toppings alphabetically
    GROUP_CONCAT(topping_name_display, ', ') AS ingredients_str
  FROM (
    SELECT
      row_id,
      order_id,
      customer_id,
      pizza_name,
      topping_name_display,
      cnt
    FROM ingredients_sorted
    ORDER BY
      row_id,
      -- ordering by count desc (so 2x first) and alphabetically
      CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
      topping_name_display
  )
  GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_name
)
SELECT
  ia.row_id,
  ia.order_id,
  ia.customer_id,
  ia.pizza_name,
  ia.pizza_name || ': ' || ia.ingredients_str AS final_ingredients
FROM ingredients_agg ia
ORDER BY ia.row_id ASC
;

  FROM pizza_get_exclusions ex

    ex.row_id,
    t.topping_name
  FROM pizza_get_extras ex

),
base_adj AS (
  SELECT
    rt.row_id,
    rt.topping_name
  FROM recipe_toppings rt
  LEFT JOIN excluded_toppings et ON rt.row_id = et.row_id AND rt.topping_name = et.topping_name
  WHERE et.topping_name IS NULL
),
all_toppings AS (
  SELECT row_id, topping_name, COUNT(*) as count FROM (
    SELECT row_id, topping_name FROM base_adj

ingredients AS (
  SELECT
    row_id,
    GROUP_CONCAT(
      CASE WHEN count > 1 THEN '2x' || topping_name ELSE topping_name END,

    SELECT * FROM all_toppings

  ) sub

)

  pb.row_id,

  pb.customer_id,
  pb.pizza_name,

WITH baseline_end_date AS (
  SELECT DATE('2020-06-15') AS ref_date
),

periods AS (
  SELECT
    date(ref_date, '-84 day') AS period_start,
    date(ref_date, '-1 day') AS period_end,
    'before' AS period
  FROM baseline_end_date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    date(ref_date, '+1 day') AS period_start,
    date(ref_date, '+84 day') AS period_end,
    'after' AS period
  FROM baseline_end_date
),

-- Calculate total sales per attribute type and attribute value during the periods
sales_by_attribute AS (
  SELECT
    'region' AS attribute_type,
    region AS attribute_value,
    p.period,
    SUM(sales) AS total_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales ws
  JOIN periods p ON ws.week_date BETWEEN p.period_start AND p.period_end
  GROUP BY region, p.period

  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT
    'platform' AS attribute_type,
    platform AS attribute_value,
    p.period,
    SUM(sales) AS total_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales ws
  JOIN periods p ON ws.week_date BETWEEN p.period_start AND p.period_end
  GROUP BY platform, p.period

  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT
    'age band' AS attribute_type,
    age_band AS attribute_value,
    p.period,
    SUM(sales) AS total_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales ws
  JOIN periods p ON ws.week_date BETWEEN p.period_start AND p.period_end
  GROUP BY age_band, p.period

  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT
    'demographic' AS attribute_type,
    demographic AS attribute_value,
    p.period,
    SUM(sales) AS total_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales ws
  JOIN periods p ON ws.week_date BETWEEN p.period_start AND p.period_end
  GROUP BY demographic, p.period

  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT
    'customer type' AS attribute_type,
    customer_type AS attribute_value,
    p.period,
    SUM(sales) AS total_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales ws
  JOIN periods p ON ws.week_date BETWEEN p.period_start AND p.period_end
  GROUP BY customer_type, p.period
),

-- Calculate percentage change for each attribute value
pct_change_by_attr_val AS (
  SELECT
    attribute_type,
    attribute_value,
    (MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'after' THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) - MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'before' THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
    NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'before' THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pct_change
  FROM sales_by_attribute
  GROUP BY attribute_type, attribute_value
),

-- Calculate average percentage change by attribute type
avg_pct_change_by_attr_type AS (
  SELECT
    attribute_type,
    AVG(pct_change) AS avg_pct_change
  FROM pct_change_by_attr_val
  GROUP BY attribute_type
),

-- Identify attribute type with the largest negative impact (smallest avg pct change)
worst_impact AS (
  SELECT
    attribute_type,
    avg_pct_change
  FROM avg_pct_change_by_attr_type
  ORDER BY avg_pct_change ASC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
  (SELECT attribute_type FROM worst_impact) AS attribute_type_with_highest_negative_impact,
  (SELECT avg_pct_change FROM worst_impact) AS average_percentage_change_in_sales
;

WITH sales_before_after AS (
  SELECT
    region,
    platform,
    segment AS demographic,
    customer_type,
    SUM(CASE WHEN week_date >= date('2020-06-15', '-84 days') AND week_date < '2020-06-15' THEN sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before,
    SUM(CASE WHEN week_date >= '2020-06-15' AND week_date < date('2020-06-15', '+84 days') THEN sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after
  FROM weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date >= date('2020-06-15', '-84 days') AND week_date < date('2020-06-15', '+84 days')
  GROUP BY region, platform, segment, customer_type
),

pct_changes AS (
  SELECT region AS attribute_value, 'region' AS attribute_type,
         CASE WHEN sales_before = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (sales_after - sales_before) * 100.0 / sales_before END AS pct_change
  FROM sales_before_after
  UNION ALL
  SELECT platform, 'platform',
         CASE WHEN sales_before = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (sales_after - sales_before) * 100.0 / sales_before END
  FROM sales_before_after
  UNION ALL
  SELECT demographic, 'demographic',
         CASE WHEN sales_before = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (sales_after - sales_before) * 100.0 / sales_before END
  FROM sales_before_after
  UNION ALL
  SELECT customer_type, 'customer_type',
         CASE WHEN sales_before = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (sales_after - sales_before) * 100.0 / sales_before END
  FROM sales_before_after
),

avg_pct_change_by_type AS (
  SELECT attribute_type, AVG(pct_change) AS avg_pct_change
  FROM pct_changes
  WHERE pct_change IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY attribute_type
),

negative_impact AS (
  SELECT attribute_type, avg_pct_change
  FROM avg_pct_change_by_type
  ORDER BY avg_pct_change
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT * FROM negative_impact;

WITH filtered_events AS (
    SELECT
        sce.page_id,
        sce.product_id,
        sce.event_type
    FROM shopping_cart_events sce
    WHERE sce.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
),
views AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS view_count
    FROM filtered_events
    WHERE event_type = 'view'
    GROUP BY product_id
),
adds AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS add_count
    FROM filtered_events
    WHERE event_type = 'add'
    GROUP BY product_id
),
leaves AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS leave_count
    FROM filtered_events
    WHERE event_type = 'leave_without_purchase'
    GROUP BY product_id
),
purchases AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS purchase_count
    FROM filtered_events
    WHERE event_type = 'purchase'
    GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(v.product_id, a.product_id, l.product_id, p.product_id) AS product_id,
    COALESCE(view_count, 0) AS view_count,
    COALESCE(add_count, 0) AS add_count,
    COALESCE(leave_count, 0) AS leave_count,
    COALESCE(purchase_count, 0) AS purchase_count
FROM views v
FULL OUTER JOIN adds a ON v.product_id = a.product_id
FULL OUTER JOIN leaves l ON COALESCE(v.product_id, a.product_id) = l.product_id
FULL OUTER JOIN purchases p ON COALESCE(v.product_id, a.product_id, l.product_id) = p.product_id
ORDER BY product_id;

WITH EligibleFilms AS (
    SELECT f.film_id
    FROM film f
    JOIN language l ON f.language_id = l.language_id
    JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id
    JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
    WHERE l.name = 'English'
      AND c.name = 'Children'
      AND (f.rating = 'G' OR f.rating = 'PG')
      AND f.length <= 120
      AND f.release_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010
), ActorFilmCounts AS (
    SELECT fa.actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_count
    FROM film_actor fa
    JOIN EligibleFilms ef ON fa.film_id = ef.film_id
    GROUP BY fa.actor_id
)
SELECT a.first_name || ' ' || a.last_name AS actor_full_name
FROM ActorFilmCounts afc
JOIN actor a ON afc.actor_id = a.actor_id
ORDER BY afc.film_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH delivered_orders AS (

customer_recency AS (

max_date AS (

customer_r AS (
    SELECT 
        r.customer_unique_id,
        julianday(m.max_order_date) - julianday(r.last_purchase_date) AS recency_days
    FROM customer_recency r, max_date m
),
customer_f AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS frequency
    FROM delivered_orders
    GROUP BY customer_unique_id
),
customer_m AS (
    SELECT o.customer_unique_id, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS monetary
    FROM delivered_orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_unique_id
),
quantiles AS (
    SELECT
        customer_unique_id,
        recency_days,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY recency_days) AS R_score,
        frequency,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY frequency DESC) AS F_score,
        monetary,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY monetary DESC) AS M_score
    FROM (
        SELECT r.customer_unique_id, r.recency_days, f.frequency, m.monetary
        FROM customer_r r
        JOIN customer_f f ON r.customer_unique_id = f.customer_unique_id
        JOIN customer_m m ON r.customer_unique_id = m.customer_unique_id
    ) sub
),
rfm_segments AS (
    SELECT
        customer_unique_id,
        R_score AS R,
        F_score AS F,
        M_score AS M,
        CAST(R_score AS TEXT) || CAST(F_score AS TEXT) || CAST(M_score AS TEXT) AS RFM_score,
        (F_score + M_score) AS FM_sum,
        CASE
            WHEN R_score = 1 AND FM_sum BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
            WHEN R_score IN (4, 5) AND FM_sum BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can''t Lose Them'
            WHEN R_score IN (4, 5) AND FM_sum BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
            WHEN R_score IN (4, 5) AND FM_sum BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
            WHEN R_score IN (2, 3) AND FM_sum BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
            WHEN R_score = 3 AND FM_sum BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
            WHEN R_score = 1 AND FM_sum BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
            WHEN (R_score = 1 AND FM_sum BETWEEN 5 AND 6) OR (R_score = 2 AND FM_sum BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
            WHEN R_score = 1 AND FM_sum BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
            WHEN R_score = 2 AND FM_sum BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
            WHEN R_score = 3 AND FM_sum BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
            ELSE 'Others'
        END AS segment
    FROM quantiles
),
customer_order_summary AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_unique_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders,
        SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS total_spend

    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
rfm_avg_sales AS (
    SELECT
        s.segment,
        AVG(co.total_spend / co.total_orders) AS avg_sales_per_order
    FROM rfm_segments s
    JOIN customer_order_summary co ON s.customer_unique_id = co.customer_unique_id
    GROUP BY s.segment
)

SELECT * FROM rfm_avg_sales
ORDER BY avg_sales_per_order DESC;

WITH month_indices AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT mth FROM monthly_sales
  WHERE mth >= '2016-01-01'
  ORDER BY mth
),
numbered_months AS (
  SELECT mth, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mth) AS month_index
  FROM month_indices
),

sales_data AS (
  SELECT
    ms.product_id,
    nm.month_index,
    ms.qty AS sales_amount
  FROM monthly_sales ms
  JOIN numbered_months nm ON ms.mth = nm.mth
  WHERE ms.product_id IN (4160, 7790)
    AND nm.month_index BETWEEN 1 AND 36
),

-- Calculate centered moving average (CMA) using 12-month overlapping windows for each product
cma_calc AS (
  SELECT
    s1.product_id,
    s1.month_index,
    (
      (SELECT AVG(sales_amount) FROM sales_data s2
       WHERE s2.product_id = s1.product_id
         AND s2.month_index BETWEEN s1.month_index - 6 AND s1.month_index + 5) +
      (SELECT AVG(sales_amount) FROM sales_data s3
       WHERE s3.product_id = s1.product_id
         AND s3.month_index BETWEEN s1.month_index - 5 AND s1.month_index + 6)
    ) / 2.0 AS cma_value
  FROM sales_data s1
  WHERE s1.month_index BETWEEN 7 AND 30
),

-- Join sales and CMA to get sales-to-CMA ratio
sales_cma_ratio AS (
  SELECT
    sd.product_id,
    sd.month_index,
    sd.sales_amount,
    c.cma_value,
    (CAST(sd.sales_amount AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(c.cma_value, 0)) AS sales_to_cma_ratio
  FROM sales_data sd
  JOIN cma_calc c
    ON sd.product_id = c.product_id
   AND sd.month_index = c.month_index
  WHERE sd.month_index BETWEEN 7 AND 30
),

-- Using weighted regression method to forecast sales for 2018 (months 25 to 36 are 2018 months in the 3-year span)
weights AS (
  SELECT
    month_index,
    CASE WHEN month_index BETWEEN 7 AND 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS weight
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT month_index FROM sales_data)
),

weighted_sums AS (
  SELECT
    sd.product_id,
    SUM(sd.month_index * w.weight) AS sum_xw,
    SUM(sd.sales_amount * w.weight) AS sum_yw,
    SUM(sd.month_index * sd.sales_amount * w.weight) AS sum_xyw,
    SUM(sd.month_index * sd.month_index * w.weight) AS sum_x2w,
    SUM(w.weight) AS sum_w
  FROM sales_data sd
  JOIN weights w ON sd.month_index = w.month_index
  GROUP BY sd.product_id
),

regression_params AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    (sum_w * sum_xyw - sum_xw * sum_yw) * 1.0 / NULLIF((sum_w * sum_x2w - sum_xw * sum_xw), 0) AS slope,
    (sum_yw - (sum_w * sum_xyw - sum_xw * sum_yw) * 1.0 / NULLIF((sum_w * sum_x2w - sum_xw * sum_xw), 0) * sum_xw) * 1.0 / NULLIF(sum_w, 0) AS intercept
  FROM weighted_sums
),

forecast_2018 AS (
  SELECT
    rp.product_id,
    m.month_index,
    (rp.intercept + rp.slope * m.month_index) AS forecasted_sales
  FROM regression_params rp
  JOIN (SELECT 25 AS month_index UNION SELECT 26 UNION SELECT 27 UNION SELECT 28 UNION SELECT 29 UNION SELECT 30 UNION SELECT 31 UNION SELECT 32 UNION SELECT 33 UNION SELECT 34 UNION SELECT 35 UNION SELECT 36) m
),

avg_forecast_annual_sales AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    AVG(forecasted_sales) AS avg_annual_sales
  FROM forecast_2018
  GROUP BY product_id
)

SELECT product_id, avg_annual_sales
FROM avg_forecast_annual_sales
ORDER BY product_id;

WITH yearly_cause_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    strftime('%Y', collision_date) AS year,
    primary_collision_factor AS cause,
    COUNT(*) AS cause_count
  FROM collisions
  GROUP BY year, cause
),

ranked_causes AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    cause,
    cause_count,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY cause_count DESC) AS cause_rank
  FROM yearly_cause_counts
),

most_common_causes AS (
  SELECT year, cause
  FROM ranked_causes
  WHERE cause_rank <= 2
  ORDER BY year, cause_rank
),

cause_years AS (
  SELECT year,
    GROUP_CONCAT(cause ORDER BY cause) AS two_most_common_causes
  FROM most_common_causes
  GROUP BY year
),

cause_pattern AS (
  SELECT two_most_common_causes,
         GROUP_CONCAT(year, ',') AS years
  FROM cause_years
  GROUP BY two_most_common_causes
  HAVING COUNT(year) = 1
)

SELECT years AS year_with_unique_top_2_causes
FROM cause_pattern
LIMIT 1;

WITH YearCauseCounts AS (
  SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', collision_date) AS year,
         primary_collision_factor AS cause,
         COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM collisions
  WHERE primary_collision_factor IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, cause
), RankedCauses AS (
  SELECT year, cause, count,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY count DESC) AS rank
  FROM YearCauseCounts
), TopTwoCauses AS (
  SELECT year, cause
  FROM RankedCauses
  WHERE rank <= 2
), YearCausePairs AS (
  SELECT year, GROUP_CONCAT(cause, ',') AS causes
  FROM TopTwoCauses
  GROUP BY year
), CommonCauses AS (
  SELECT causes
  FROM YearCausePairs
  GROUP BY causes
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT year
FROM YearCausePairs
WHERE causes NOT IN (SELECT causes FROM CommonCauses)
LIMIT 1;

WITH max_stats AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(G) AS max_games,
        MAX(R) AS max_runs,
        MAX(H) AS max_hits,
        MAX(HR) AS max_home_runs
    FROM batting
)
SELECT
    p.name_given,
    b.G AS games_played,
    b.R AS runs,
    b.H AS hits,
    b.HR AS home_runs
FROM player p
JOIN batting b ON p.player_id = b.player_id
JOIN max_stats ms ON 
    (b.G = ms.max_games OR
    b.R = ms.max_runs OR
    b.H = ms.max_hits OR
    b.HR = ms.max_home_runs)
ORDER BY
    b.G DESC,
    b.R DESC,
    b.H DESC,
    b.HR DESC;

WITH TrackDuration AS (
    SELECT 
        TrackId, 
        Milliseconds / 60000.0 AS DurationMin
    FROM Track
),
Stats AS (
    SELECT 
        MIN(DurationMin) AS MinDuration,
        AVG(DurationMin) AS AvgDuration,
        MAX(DurationMin) AS MaxDuration
    FROM TrackDuration
),
Categories AS (
    SELECT 
        t.TrackId,
        t.DurationMin,
        CASE
            WHEN t.DurationMin <= (s.MinDuration + s.AvgDuration) / 2 THEN 'Short'
            WHEN t.DurationMin <= (s.AvgDuration + s.MaxDuration) / 2 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Long'
        END AS DurationCategory
    FROM TrackDuration t, Stats s
),
InvoiceData AS (
    SELECT 
        il.TrackId,
        SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS Revenue
    FROM InvoiceLine il
    GROUP BY il.TrackId
),
CategoryRevenue AS (
    SELECT
        c.DurationCategory,
        MIN(c.DurationMin) AS MinDuration,
        MAX(c.DurationMin) AS MaxDuration,
        SUM(COALESCE(i.Revenue,0)) AS TotalRevenue
    FROM Categories c
    LEFT JOIN InvoiceData i ON c.TrackId = i.TrackId
    GROUP BY c.DurationCategory
)
SELECT DurationCategory, MinDuration, MaxDuration, TotalRevenue
FROM CategoryRevenue
ORDER BY DurationCategory;

WITH TrackDurations AS (
  SELECT
    TrackId,
    Milliseconds,
    Milliseconds / 60000.0 AS DurationMinutes
  FROM Track
),
Stats AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(DurationMinutes) AS MinDuration,
    AVG(DurationMinutes) AS AvgDuration,
    MAX(DurationMinutes) AS MaxDuration
  FROM TrackDurations
),
Categories AS (
  SELECT
    t.TrackId,
    t.DurationMinutes,
    CASE
      WHEN t.DurationMinutes <= (s.MinDuration + s.AvgDuration) / 2 THEN 'Short'
      WHEN t.DurationMinutes <= (s.AvgDuration + s.MaxDuration) / 2 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Long'
    END AS LengthCategory
  FROM TrackDurations t, Stats s
),
RevenueByCategory AS (
  SELECT
    c.LengthCategory,
    MIN(c.DurationMinutes) AS MinDuration,
    MAX(c.DurationMinutes) AS MaxDuration,
    SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS TotalRevenue
  FROM Categories c
  JOIN InvoiceLine il ON c.TrackId = il.TrackId
  GROUP BY c.LengthCategory
)
SELECT LengthCategory, MinDuration, MaxDuration, TotalRevenue
FROM RevenueByCategory
ORDER BY 
  CASE LengthCategory
    WHEN 'Short' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2
    WHEN 'Long' THEN 3
  END;

WITH sales_us AS (
  SELECT 
    s.prod_id,
    c.cust_city AS city,
    t.calendar_quarter_id,
    s.promo_id,
    s.amount_sold
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_iso_code = 'US'
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
),

city_sales AS (
  SELECT city, calendar_quarter_id, SUM(amount_sold) AS total_sales
  FROM sales_us
  GROUP BY city, calendar_quarter_id
),

city_growth AS (
  SELECT 
    city,
    MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2019_q4,
    MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2020_q4
  FROM city_sales
  GROUP BY city
  HAVING sales_2020_q4 >= 1.2 * sales_2019_q4
),

prod_city_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    su.prod_id,
    su.city,
    su.calendar_quarter_id,
    SUM(su.amount_sold) AS total_sales
  FROM sales_us su
  WHERE su.city IN (SELECT city FROM city_growth)
  GROUP BY su.prod_id, su.city, su.calendar_quarter_id
),

prod_qtr_sales AS (
  SELECT
    prod_id,
    calendar_quarter_id,
    SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales
  FROM prod_city_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_quarter_id
),

all_prods_per_qtr AS (
  SELECT 
    calendar_quarter_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT prod_id) AS prod_count
  FROM prod_qtr_sales
  GROUP BY calendar_quarter_id
),

prod_sales_ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    pqs.prod_id,
    pqs.calendar_quarter_id,
    pqs.total_sales,
    apr.prod_count,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pqs.calendar_quarter_id ORDER BY pqs.total_sales DESC) AS rank
  FROM prod_qtr_sales pqs
  JOIN all_prods_per_qtr apr ON pqs.calendar_quarter_id = apr.calendar_quarter_id
),

prod_top_20_percent AS (
  SELECT 
    prod_id,
    calendar_quarter_id,
    total_sales
  FROM prod_sales_ranked
  WHERE rank <= CEIL(prod_count * 0.2)
),

total_sales_per_qtr AS (
  SELECT calendar_quarter_id, SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales_all
  FROM prod_top_20_percent
  GROUP BY calendar_quarter_id
),

prod_share AS (
  SELECT
    pt20.prod_id,
    pt20.calendar_quarter_id,
    pt20.total_sales,
    (pt20.total_sales * 1.0) / tspq.total_sales_all AS sales_share
  FROM prod_top_20_percent pt20
  JOIN total_sales_per_qtr tspq ON pt20.calendar_quarter_id = tspq.calendar_quarter_id
),

prod_share_change AS (
  SELECT 
    ps19.prod_id,
    ps19.sales_share AS share_2019_q4,
    COALESCE(ps20.sales_share, 0) AS share_2020_q4,
    ABS(COALESCE(ps20.sales_share, 0) - ps19.sales_share) AS share_change
  FROM prod_share ps19
  LEFT JOIN prod_share ps20 ON ps19.prod_id = ps20.prod_id AND ps20.calendar_quarter_id = 1776
  WHERE ps19.calendar_quarter_id = 1772
)

SELECT prod_id
FROM prod_share_change
ORDER BY share_change ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH us_customers AS (
  SELECT cust_id, cust_city
  FROM customers
  WHERE country_id = (SELECT country_id FROM countries WHERE country_name = 'United States' LIMIT 1)
),

sales_q4_2019 AS (
  SELECT prod_id, cust_city, SUM(amount_sold) AS sales_2019
  FROM sales
  JOIN us_customers USING(cust_id)
  JOIN times ON sales.time_id = times.time_id
  WHERE promo_id = 999 AND times.calendar_quarter_id = 1772
  GROUP BY prod_id, cust_city
),

sales_q4_2020 AS (
  SELECT prod_id, cust_city, SUM(amount_sold) AS sales_2020
  FROM sales
  JOIN us_customers USING(cust_id)
  JOIN times ON sales.time_id = times.time_id
  WHERE promo_id = 999 AND times.calendar_quarter_id = 1776
  GROUP BY prod_id, cust_city
),

city_sales_2019 AS (
  SELECT cust_city, SUM(sales_2019) AS city_sales_2019
  FROM sales_q4_2019
  GROUP BY cust_city
),

city_sales_2020 AS (
  SELECT cust_city, SUM(sales_2020) AS city_sales_2020
  FROM sales_q4_2020
  GROUP BY cust_city
),

city_growth AS (
  SELECT c19.cust_city
  FROM city_sales_2019 c19
  JOIN city_sales_2020 c20 ON c19.cust_city = c20.cust_city
  WHERE c20.city_sales_2020 >= 1.2 * c19.city_sales_2019
),

filtered_sales_2019 AS (
  SELECT prod_id, SUM(amount_sold) AS sales_2019
  FROM sales
  JOIN us_customers USING(cust_id)
  JOIN times ON sales.time_id = times.time_id
  WHERE promo_id = 999 AND times.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 AND cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM city_growth)
  GROUP BY prod_id
),

filtered_sales_2020 AS (
  SELECT prod_id, SUM(amount_sold) AS sales_2020
  FROM sales
  JOIN us_customers USING(cust_id)
  JOIN times ON sales.time_id = times.time_id
  WHERE promo_id = 999 AND times.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 AND cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM city_growth)
  GROUP BY prod_id
),

all_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id FROM filtered_sales_2019
  UNION
  SELECT prod_id FROM filtered_sales_2020
),

total_sales_combined AS (
  SELECT
    p.prod_id,
    COALESCE(f19.sales_2019, 0) AS sales_2019,
    COALESCE(f20.sales_2020, 0) AS sales_2020,
    COALESCE(f19.sales_2019, 0) + COALESCE(f20.sales_2020, 0) AS total_sales
  FROM all_products p
  LEFT JOIN filtered_sales_2019 f19 ON p.prod_id = f19.prod_id
  LEFT JOIN filtered_sales_2020 f20 ON p.prod_id = f20.prod_id
),

total_2019_2020 AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(sales_2019) AS sum_2019,
    SUM(sales_2020) AS sum_2020
  FROM total_sales_combined
),

product_shares AS (
  SELECT
    t.prod_id,
    t.sales_2019,
    t.sales_2020,
    (t.sales_2019 * 1.0) / tot.sum_2019 AS share_2019,
    (t.sales_2020 * 1.0) / tot.sum_2020 AS share_2020,
    100.0 * ((t.sales_2020 * 1.0) / tot.sum_2020 - (t.sales_2019 * 1.0) / tot.sum_2019) AS pct_point_change,
    t.total_sales
  FROM total_sales_combined t, total_2019_2020 tot
),

percentile_80_threshold AS (
  SELECT MIN(total_sales) AS threshold FROM (
    SELECT total_sales FROM product_shares ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) * 0.2 AS INTEGER) FROM product_shares)
  )
),

top_20_percent_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id
  FROM product_shares
  WHERE total_sales >= (SELECT threshold FROM percentile_80_threshold)
)

SELECT prod_id, pct_point_change
FROM product_shares
WHERE prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top_20_percent_products)
ORDER BY ABS(pct_point_change) ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH player_runs AS (
  SELECT
    pm.player_id,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) AS matches_played,
    SUM(CASE WHEN w.wicket_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissals,
    MAX(bs.runs_scored) AS highest_score,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bs.runs_scored >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches_30_plus,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bs.runs_scored >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches_50_plus,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bs.runs_scored >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches_100_plus,
    SUM(bs.balls_faced) AS balls_faced
  FROM player_match pm
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON pm.player_id = bs.player_id AND pm.match_id = bs.match_id
  LEFT JOIN wicket_taken w ON pm.player_id = w.player_out_id AND pm.match_id = w.match_id
  GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
player_bowling AS (
  SELECT
    pt.player_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(bt.wicket_id IS NOT NULL), 0) AS total_wickets,
    SUM(bb.balls_bowled) AS balls_bowled,
    SUM(bb.runs_given) AS runs_given,
    COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(bb.runs_given) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(bb.balls_bowled), 0), 2), 0) AS economy_rate
  FROM player_match pt
  LEFT JOIN wicket_taken bt ON pt.player_id = bt.player_id AND pt.match_id = bt.match_id
  LEFT JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON pt.player_id = bb.bowler_id AND pt.match_id = bb.match_id
  GROUP BY pt.player_id
),
best_bowling_performance AS (
  SELECT
    bowler_id AS player_id,
    MAX(wickets) AS max_wickets
  FROM (
    SELECT
      bowler_id,
      match_id,
      COUNT(wicket_id) AS wickets,
      SUM(runs_given) AS runs_given
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON wt.player_id = bb.bowler_id AND wt.match_id = bb.match_id AND wt.over = bb.over AND wt.ball = bb.ball
    GROUP BY bowler_id, match_id
  )
  GROUP BY bowler_id
),
best_bowling_detail AS (
  SELECT
    bowler_id AS player_id,
    match_id,
    wickets,
    runs_given
  FROM (
    SELECT
      bowler_id,
      match_id,
      COUNT(wicket_id) AS wickets,
      SUM(runs_given) AS runs_given,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY bowler_id
        ORDER BY COUNT(wicket_id) DESC, SUM(runs_given) ASC
      ) AS rk
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON wt.player_id = bb.bowler_id AND wt.match_id = bb.match_id AND wt.over = bb.over AND wt.ball = bb.ball
    GROUP BY bowler_id, match_id
  )
  WHERE rk = 1
),
player_role AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    role,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
  FROM player_match
  GROUP BY player_id, role
),
most_frequent_role AS (
  SELECT player_id, role FROM player_role WHERE rn = 1
)

SELECT
  p.player_id,
  p.player_name,
  mfr.role AS most_frequent_role,
  p.batting_hand,
  p.bowling_skill,
  pr.total_runs,
  pr.matches_played,
  pr.dismissals,
  CASE WHEN pr.dismissals > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(pr.total_runs AS FLOAT) / pr.dismissals, 2) ELSE NULL END AS batting_average,
  pr.highest_score,
  pr.matches_30_plus,
  pr.matches_50_plus,
  pr.matches_100_plus,
  pr.balls_faced,
  CASE WHEN pr.balls_faced > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(pr.total_runs AS FLOAT) / pr.balls_faced * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END AS strike_rate,
  pb.total_wickets,
  pb.economy_rate,
  CASE
    WHEN bbp.wickets IS NOT NULL
    THEN bbp.wickets || '-' || bbp.runs_given
    ELSE NULL
  END AS best_bowling_performance
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN player_runs pr ON p.player_id = pr.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_bowling pb ON p.player_id = pb.player_id
LEFT JOIN best_bowling_detail bbp ON p.player_id = bbp.player_id
LEFT JOIN most_frequent_role mfr ON p.player_id = mfr.player_id
ORDER BY p.player_id;

treatment.sql:
WITH PlayerRoles AS (
    SELECT pm.player_id, pm.role, COUNT(*) as role_count,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pm.player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rank_role
    FROM player_match pm
    GROUP BY pm.player_id, pm.role
),
MostFrequentRoles AS (
    SELECT player_id, role
    FROM PlayerRoles
    WHERE rank_role = 1
),
PlayerBattingStats AS (
    SELECT bs.match_id, bs.innings_no, bs.striker as player_id,
           SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs,
           COUNT(DISTINCT bs.match_id) as total_matches_played,
           COUNT(wt.player_out) as total_dismissals,
           MAX(bs.runs_scored) as highest_score,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN bs.runs_scored >= 30 THEN 1 END) as matches_30plus,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN bs.runs_scored >= 50 THEN 1 END) as matches_50plus,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN bs.runs_scored >= 100 THEN 1 END) as matches_100plus,
           COUNT(bs.ball_id) as total_balls_faced
    FROM ball_by_ball bs
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt
    ON bs.match_id = wt.match_id AND bs.over_id = wt.over_id AND bs.ball_id = wt.ball_id AND bs.innings_no = wt.innings_no AND bs.striker = wt.player_out
    GROUP BY bs.striker
),
PlayerBowlingStats AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler as player_id,
           COUNT(wt.player_out) as total_wickets,
           COUNT(bb.ball_id) as total_balls_bowled,
           SUM(COALESCE(bb_runs_runs.runs_scored, 0)) as total_runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt
    ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id AND bb.over_id = wt.over_id AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = wt.innings_no AND bb.bowler = wt.player_out
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT match_id, over_id, ball_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_scored
        FROM batsman_scored
        GROUP BY match_id, over_id, ball_id
    ) bb_runs_runs ON bb.match_id = bb_runs_runs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bb_runs_runs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bb_runs_runs.ball_id
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
BestBowlingPerformance AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler as player_id, bb.match_id,
           COUNT(wt.player_out) as wickets,
           SUM(COALESCE(bb_runs_runs.runs_scored, 0)) as runs_given
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt
    ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id AND bb.over_id = wt.over_id AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = wt.innings_no
       AND bb.bowler = wt.player_out
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT match_id, over_id, ball_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_scored
        FROM batsman_scored
        GROUP BY match_id, over_id, ball_id
    ) bb_runs_runs ON bb.match_id = bb_runs_runs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bb_runs_runs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bb_runs_runs.ball_id
    GROUP BY bb.bowler, bb.match_id
),
BestBowlingRanked AS (
    SELECT player_id, match_id, wickets, runs_given,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY wickets DESC, runs_given ASC) as rank_performance
    FROM BestBowlingPerformance
),
BestBowlingFormatted AS (
    SELECT player_id, CAST(wickets AS TEXT) || '-' || CAST(runs_given AS TEXT) AS best_bowling
    FROM BestBowlingRanked
    WHERE rank_performance = 1
),
PlayerFinal AS (
    SELECT p.player_id, p.player_name, mfr.role as most_frequent_role, p.batting_hand, p.bowling_skill,
           COALESCE(bs.total_runs, 0) as total_runs,
           COALESCE(bs.total_matches_played, 0) as total_matches_played,
           COALESCE(bs.total_dismissals, 0) as total_dismissals,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(bs.total_dismissals, 0) > 0 THEN
                CAST(bs.total_runs AS FLOAT) / bs.total_dismissals ELSE NULL END as batting_average,
           COALESCE(bs.highest_score, 0) as highest_score,
           COALESCE(bs.matches_30plus, 0) as matches_30plus,
           COALESCE(bs.matches_50plus, 0) as matches_50plus,
           COALESCE(bs.matches_100plus, 0) as matches_100plus,
           COALESCE(bs.total_balls_faced, 0) as total_balls_faced,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(bs.total_balls_faced, 0) > 0 THEN
                (CAST(bs.total_runs AS FLOAT) / bs.total_balls_faced) * 100 ELSE NULL END as strike_rate,
           COALESCE(bow.total_wickets, 0) as total_wickets,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(bow.total_balls_bowled, 0) > 0 THEN
                CAST(bow.total_runs_conceded AS FLOAT) / bow.total_balls_bowled * 6 ELSE NULL END as economy_rate,
           COALESCE(bb.best_bowling, '0-0') as best_bowling
    FROM player p
    LEFT JOIN MostFrequentRoles mfr ON p.player_id = mfr.player_id
    LEFT JOIN PlayerBattingStats bs ON p.player_id = bs.player_id
    LEFT JOIN PlayerBowlingStats bow ON p.player_id = bow.player_id
    LEFT JOIN BestBowlingFormatted bb ON p.player_id = bb.player_id
)
SELECT * FROM PlayerFinal
ORDER BY player_id;

WITH NXT_matches AS (
    SELECT
        m.match_id,
        m.duration,
        w1.name AS wrestler1,
        w2.name AS wrestler2
    FROM Matches m
    JOIN Wrestlers w1 ON m.wrestler1_id = w1.wrestler_id
    JOIN Wrestlers w2 ON m.wrestler2_id = w2.wrestler_id
    JOIN Match_Types mt ON m.match_type_id = mt.match_type_id
    WHERE mt.name LIKE '%NXT%'
      AND mt.name NOT LIKE '%title change%'
),
Shortest_NXT_match AS (
    SELECT MIN(duration) AS shortest_duration FROM NXT_matches
)
SELECT wrestler1, wrestler2
FROM NXT_matches
WHERE duration = (SELECT shortest_duration FROM Shortest_NXT_match)
LIMIT 1;

treatment.sql:
WITH NXT_Title_Matches AS (
  SELECT m.id, m.duration, m.title_change
  FROM Matches m
  JOIN Match_Types mt ON m.match_type_id = mt.id
  WHERE mt.name LIKE '%NXT%'
    AND m.title_change = 0
    AND m.title_id IS NOT NULL
),
Parsed_Duration AS (
  SELECT id, CAST(substr(duration, 1, instr(duration, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
             CAST(substr(duration, instr(duration, ':') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS duration_seconds
  FROM NXT_Title_Matches
),
Shortest_Match AS (
  SELECT id, MIN(duration_seconds) AS min_duration
  FROM Parsed_Duration
  GROUP BY id
  ORDER BY min_duration ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
Match_Wrestlers AS (
  SELECT id, winner_id, loser_id
  FROM Matches
  WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM Shortest_Match)
),
Wrestler_Names AS (
  SELECT w.name, w.id
  FROM Wrestlers w

    SUM(order_items.price) AS total_sales
  FROM orders

  JOIN toy_products ON order_items.product_id = toy_products.product_id

    (AVG(day_num * total_sales) - AVG(day_num) * AVG(total_sales)) / (AVG(day_num * day_num) - AVG(day_num) * AVG(day_num)) AS slope
  FROM train_data
), intercept_slope AS (
  SELECT
    mean_y - slope * mean_x AS intercept,
    slope
  FROM params

WITH first_five_laps AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT race_id, lap
  FROM lap_times
  WHERE lap <= 5
),
retired_drivers AS (
  SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap AS retirement_lap
  FROM retirements
),
pit_events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap
  FROM pit_stops
),
start_grid_positions AS (
  SELECT race_id, driver_id, grid
  FROM results
  WHERE grid > 0
),
overtakes AS (
  SELECT 
    curr.race_id,
    curr.lap,
    prev.driver_id AS overtaken_driver_id,
    curr.driver_id AS overtaking_driver_id,
    curr.position AS overtaking_position,
    prev.position AS overtaken_position
  FROM lap_positions curr
  JOIN lap_positions prev ON curr.race_id = prev.race_id
    AND curr.lap = prev.lap + 1
    AND curr.position = prev.position - 1
    AND curr.driver_id != prev.driver_id
    AND curr.race_id IN (SELECT race_id FROM first_five_laps)
),
overtake_labels AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    CASE
      WHEN r.retirement_lap = o.lap THEN 'R'
      WHEN p_current.lap = o.lap OR p_prev.lap = o.lap - 1 THEN 'P'
      WHEN o.lap = 1 
           AND s1.grid IS NOT NULL AND s2.grid IS NOT NULL
           AND ABS(s1.grid - s2.grid) <= 2 THEN 'S'
      ELSE 'T'
    END AS category
  FROM overtakes o
  LEFT JOIN retired_drivers r ON o.race_id = r.race_id AND o.overtaken_driver_id = r.driver_id 
  LEFT JOIN pit_events p_current ON o.race_id = p_current.race_id AND o.overtaken_driver_id = p_current.driver_id AND o.lap = p_current.lap
  LEFT JOIN pit_events p_prev ON o.race_id = p_prev.race_id AND o.overtaken_driver_id = p_prev.driver_id AND o.lap - 1 = p_prev.lap
  LEFT JOIN start_grid_positions s1 ON o.race_id = s1.race_id AND o.overtaking_driver_id = s1.driver_id
  LEFT JOIN start_grid_positions s2 ON o.race_id = s2.race_id AND o.overtaken_driver_id = s2.driver_id
)
SELECT category AS overtake_category, COUNT(*) AS overtakes_count
FROM overtake_labels
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY CASE category
  WHEN 'R' THEN 1
  WHEN 'P' THEN 2
  WHEN 'S' THEN 3
  WHEN 'T' THEN 4
  ELSE 5
END;

WITH first_five_laps AS (
    SELECT race_id, lap
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE lap <= 5
    GROUP BY race_id, lap
),

pit_lap_events AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap
    FROM pit_stops
    WHERE lap <= 5
),

retirements_first_5 AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap
    FROM retirements
    WHERE lap <= 5 AND lap IS NOT NULL
),

laps_pos_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        lp1.race_id,
        lp1.driver_id as overtaker,
        lp1.lap as lap,
        lp1.position as pos_before,
        lp2.position as pos_after
    FROM lap_positions lp1
    JOIN lap_positions lp2 ON lp1.race_id = lp2.race_id AND lp1.driver_id = lp2.driver_id AND lp1.lap + 1 = lp2.lap
    WHERE lp1.lap < 5
),

potential_overtakes AS (
    SELECT 
        race_id, overtaker, lap, pos_before, pos_after
    FROM laps_pos_diff
    WHERE pos_after < pos_before
),

possible_overtaken AS (
    SELECT
        p1.race_id,
        p1.lap,
        p1.driver_id AS overtaker,
        p2.driver_id AS overtaken,
        p1.position AS overtaker_pos_before
    FROM lap_positions p1
    JOIN lap_positions p2 ON p1.race_id = p2.race_id AND p1.lap = p2.lap
    WHERE p2.position = p1.position - 1
    AND p1.lap < 5
),

classified_overtakes AS (
    SELECT 
        po.race_id, po.lap, po.overtaker, po.pos_before, po.pos_after,
        po2.overtaken
    FROM potential_overtakes po
    JOIN possible_overtaken po2 ON po.race_id = po2.race_id AND po.lap = po2.lap AND po.overtaker = po2.overtaker
),

start_grid AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, position AS grid
    FROM qualifying
    WHERE race_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT race_id FROM first_five_laps)
),

overtakes_r AS (
    SELECT co.*
    FROM classified_overtakes co
    JOIN retirements_first_5 r ON co.race_id = r.race_id AND co.overtaken = r.driver_id AND co.lap = r.lap
),

overtakes_p AS (
    SELECT co.*
    FROM classified_overtakes co
    JOIN pit_lap_events p ON co.race_id = p.race_id AND co.overtaken = p.driver_id
    WHERE co.lap = p.lap OR co.lap = p.lap + 1
),

overtakes_s AS (
    SELECT co.*
    FROM classified_overtakes co
    JOIN start_grid sg_overtaker ON co.race_id = sg_overtaker.race_id AND co.overtaker = sg_overtaker.driver_id
    JOIN start_grid sg_overtaken ON co.race_id = sg_overtaken.race_id AND co.overtaken = sg_overtaken.driver_id
    WHERE co.lap = 1 AND ABS(sg_overtaker.grid - sg_overtaken.grid) <= 2
),

classified_final AS (
    SELECT race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken, 'R' AS category FROM overtakes_r
    UNION ALL
    SELECT race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken, 'P' AS category FROM overtakes_p WHERE (race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken) NOT IN (SELECT race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken FROM overtakes_r)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken, 'S' AS category FROM overtakes_s WHERE (race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken) NOT IN (SELECT race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken FROM overtakes_r) 
    AND (race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken) NOT IN (SELECT race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken FROM overtakes_p)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken, 'T' AS category
    FROM classified_overtakes
    WHERE (race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken) NOT IN (SELECT race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken FROM overtakes_r)
    AND (race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken) NOT IN (SELECT race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken FROM overtakes_p)
    AND (race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken) NOT IN (SELECT race_id, lap, overtaker, overtaken FROM overtakes_s)
),

result AS (
    SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS overtakes_count
    FROM classified_final
    GROUP BY category
)

SELECT * FROM result ORDER BY category ASC;

WITH monthly_interest_composition AS (
  SELECT
    month_year AS month,
    interest_id,
    AVG(composition / index_value) AS avg_composition
  FROM interest_metrics
  WHERE month_year BETWEEN '2018-09' AND '2019-08'
  GROUP BY month, interest_id
),
monthly_max_interest AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    interest_id AS max_interest,
    avg_composition AS max_index_composition
  FROM (
    SELECT
      month,
      interest_id,
      avg_composition,
      RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY avg_composition DESC) AS rnk
    FROM monthly_interest_composition
  )
  WHERE rnk = 1
),
with_lag AS (
  SELECT
    a.month,
    a.max_interest,
    a.max_index_composition,
    LAG(a.max_interest,1) OVER (ORDER BY a.month) AS prev1_interest,
    LAG(a.max_index_composition,1) OVER (ORDER BY a.month) AS prev1_max,
    LAG(a.max_interest,2) OVER (ORDER BY a.month) AS prev2_interest,

rolling_avg AS (
  SELECT

    prev1_interest,
    prev1_max,
    prev2_interest,

    AVG(max_index_composition) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_3m

WITH first_targets AS (
    SELECT 
        session_id,
        MIN(event_index) AS first_target_index
    FROM (
        SELECT
            session_id,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time) AS event_index,
            path
        FROM activity_log
        WHERE path IN ('/detail', '/complete')
    )
    GROUP BY session_id
), pre_target_events AS (
    SELECT 
        a.session_id,
        a.path,
        a.search_type,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.session_id ORDER BY a.event_time) AS event_index
    FROM activity_log a
    JOIN first_targets f ON a.session_id = f.session_id
    WHERE a.search_type != '' AND
          a.event_time < (SELECT MIN(event_time) FROM activity_log al2 
                          WHERE al2.session_id = a.session_id AND al2.path IN ('/detail', '/complete'))
), pre_count_per_session AS (
    SELECT 
        session_id,
        COUNT(*) AS pre_event_count
    FROM pre_target_events
    GROUP BY session_id
), min_pre_count AS (
    SELECT MIN(pre_event_count) AS min_count FROM pre_count_per_session
), min_sessions AS (
    SELECT session_id FROM pre_count_per_session WHERE pre_event_count = (SELECT min_count FROM min_pre_count)
)
SELECT p.session_id, p.path, p.search_type
FROM pre_target_events p
JOIN min_sessions m ON p.session_id = m.session_id
ORDER BY p.session_id, p.event_index;

  SELECT
    fs2019.prod_id,
    fs2019.month,
    fs2019.total_amount_sold AS sales_2019,
    IFNULL(fs2020.total_amount_sold, 0) AS sales_2020,
    CASE WHEN fs2019.total_amount_sold = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE ((fs2020.total_amount_sold - fs2019.total_amount_sold) * 1.0 / fs2019.total_amount_sold) END AS growth_rate
  FROM filtered_sales fs2019

  WHERE fs2019.year = 2019
),
projected_2021 AS (

    month,

  FROM projected_2021

        curr.lap,
        curr.driver_id,
        curr.position AS curr_position,
        prev.position AS prev_position
    FROM lap_positions curr
    JOIN lap_positions prev ON curr.race_id = prev.race_id AND curr.driver_id = prev.driver_id AND curr.lap = prev.lap + 1
    WHERE curr.lap > 1
),
overtaking_events AS (
    SELECT
        lc1.race_id,
        lc1.lap,
        lc1.driver_id AS overtaker,
        lc2.driver_id AS overtaken
    FROM lap_changes lc1
    JOIN lap_changes lc2 ON lc1.race_id = lc2.race_id AND lc1.lap = lc2.lap
    WHERE lc1.curr_position < lc2.curr_position AND lc1.prev_position > lc2.prev_position
),
filtered_overtaking_events AS (
    SELECT oe.*
    FROM overtaking_events oe
    LEFT JOIN pit_stops ps1 ON oe.race_id = ps1.race_id AND oe.overtaker = ps1.driver_id AND (ps1.lap = oe.lap OR ps1.lap = oe.lap - 1)
    LEFT JOIN pit_stops ps2 ON oe.race_id = ps2.race_id AND oe.overtaken = ps2.driver_id AND (ps2.lap = oe.lap OR ps2.lap = oe.lap - 1)
    LEFT JOIN retirements r1 ON oe.race_id = r1.race_id AND oe.overtaker = r1.driver_id
    LEFT JOIN retirements r2 ON oe.race_id = r2.race_id AND oe.overtaken = r2.driver_id

),

        c.cust_id,
        SUM(s.quantity_sold * (s.amount_sold / s.quantity_sold - p.prod_min_price)) AS total_profit
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN countries cn ON c.country_id = cn.country_id

      AND t.calendar_month_number = 12

        NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY total_profit) AS profit_bucket
    FROM Italian_Customers_Profit
),
Bucket_Summary AS (
    SELECT
        profit_bucket,
        COUNT(cust_id) AS num_customers,
        MIN(total_profit) AS min_total_profit,

WITH ItalianCustomers AS (
  SELECT cust_id
  FROM customers c
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
),
DecemberSales AS (
  SELECT
    s.cust_id,
    s.prod_id,
    s.quantity_sold,
    s.amount_sold,
    s.time_id,
    s.promo_id,
    s.channel_id
  FROM sales s
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE t.calendar_year = 2021 
    AND t.calendar_month_number = 12
    AND s.cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM ItalianCustomers)
),
SalesWithCosts AS (
  SELECT 
    d.cust_id,
    d.quantity_sold,
    (d.amount_sold / NULLIF(d.quantity_sold, 0)) AS unit_price, -- derive unit price from amount_sold / quantity_sold
    c.unit_cost
  FROM DecemberSales d
  JOIN costs c ON d.prod_id = c.prod_id AND d.time_id = c.time_id AND d.promo_id = c.promo_id AND d.channel_id = c.channel_id
),
CustomerProfits AS (
  SELECT 
    cust_id,
    SUM(quantity_sold * (unit_price - unit_cost)) AS total_profit
  FROM SalesWithCosts
  GROUP BY cust_id
),
ProfitStats AS (
  SELECT MIN(total_profit) AS min_profit, MAX(total_profit) AS max_profit FROM CustomerProfits
),
Buckets AS (
  SELECT
    cust_id,
    total_profit,
    CASE 
      WHEN max_profit = min_profit THEN 1
      ELSE CAST(((total_profit - min_profit) * 10.0 / (max_profit - min_profit)) AS INTEGER) + 1
    END AS bucket
  FROM CustomerProfits, ProfitStats
)
SELECT
  bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS num_customers,
  MIN(total_profit) AS min_total_profit,
  MAX(total_profit) AS max_total_profit
FROM Buckets
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket;

        s20.month,
        s20.sales_2020,

    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2020 THEN sales_amount END), 0) AS sales_2020
  FROM monthly_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id, month
),

-- (((Sales in 2020 - Sales in 2019) / Sales in 2019) * Sales in 2020) + Sales in 2020
projected_sales_2021 AS (
  SELECT
    prod_id,
    month,
    CASE
      WHEN sales_2019 = 0 THEN sales_2020
      ELSE (((sales_2020 - sales_2019) * sales_2020) / sales_2019) + sales_2020
    END AS projected_sales_amount
  FROM sales_pivot
),

-- Get exchange rates for France for 2021 by month
exchange_rates_2021 AS (
  SELECT
    co.country_id,

    cu.month,
    cu.to_us
  FROM currency cu
  JOIN countries co ON co.country_name = 'France'
  WHERE cu.year = 2021
    AND co.country_id = cu.country_id
),

-- Calculate projected sales in USD by applying exchange rates

  SELECT
    p.month,
    AVG(p.projected_sales_amount * COALESCE(er.to_us, 1)) AS avg_projected_sales_usd
  FROM projected_sales_2021 p
  LEFT JOIN exchange_rates_2021 er ON er.month = p.month
  GROUP BY p.month
)

SELECT
  month,
  ROUND(avg_projected_sales_usd, 2) AS avg_projected_monthly_sales_usd_2021
FROM projected_sales_usd
ORDER BY month;

WITH converted_volume AS (
    SELECT
        ticker,
        date,
        CASE
            WHEN volume = '-' THEN 0
            WHEN volume LIKE '%M' THEN CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'M', '') AS FLOAT) * 1000000
            WHEN volume LIKE '%K' THEN CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'K', '') AS FLOAT) * 1000
            ELSE CAST(volume AS FLOAT)
        END AS volume_num
    FROM bitcoin_prices
    WHERE date BETWEEN '2021-08-01' AND '2021-08-10'
),
filtered_volume AS (
    SELECT
        ticker,
        date,
        volume_num
    FROM converted_volume
),
prev_nonzero_volume AS (
    SELECT
        cv1.ticker,
        cv1.date,
        cv1.volume_num,
        (SELECT volume_num
         FROM filtered_volume cv2
         WHERE cv2.ticker = cv1.ticker
           AND cv2.date < cv1.date
           AND cv2.volume_num > 0
         ORDER BY cv2.date DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS prev_volume_num
    FROM filtered_volume cv1
),
daily_pct_change AS (
    SELECT
        ticker,
        date,
        volume_num,
        prev_volume_num,
        CASE
            WHEN prev_volume_num IS NULL OR prev_volume_num = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ((volume_num - prev_volume_num) / prev_volume_num) * 100
        END AS daily_volume_pct_change
    FROM prev_nonzero_volume
)
SELECT
    ticker,
    date,
    daily_volume_pct_change
FROM daily_pct_change
ORDER BY ticker, date;

WITH RECURSIVE
  -- Recursive CTE to find all nested packaging and accumulate quantities from bottom to top
  nested_packaging(parent_packaging_id, child_packaging_id, quantity) AS (
    SELECT packaging_id AS parent_packaging_id, child_packaging_id, quantity
    FROM packaging_relations
    UNION ALL
    SELECT np.parent_packaging_id, pr.child_packaging_id, pr.quantity * np.quantity
    FROM nested_packaging np
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON np.child_packaging_id = pr.parent_packaging_id
  ),

  -- Aggregate total quantity per top-level packaging and item
  item_quantities AS (
    SELECT
      p_top.packaging_id AS top_packaging_id,
      p_top.name AS top_packaging_name,
      pr.item_id,
      SUM(COALESCE(np.quantity, 1)) AS total_quantity -- multiply quantities down the chain. Use 1 for direct packaging.
    FROM packaging p_top
    LEFT JOIN nested_packaging np ON p_top.packaging_id = np.parent_packaging_id
    LEFT JOIN packaging_relations pr ON np.child_packaging_id = pr.parent_packaging_id
    OR (p_top.packaging_id = pr.parent_packaging_id AND np.child_packaging_id IS NULL)
    JOIN inventory i ON pr.item_id = i.item_id
    WHERE p_top.packaging_id NOT IN (SELECT child_packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
    GROUP BY p_top.packaging_id, p_top.name, pr.item_id
  )

SELECT
  ipq.top_packaging_name AS packaging_container_name,
  it.name AS item_name
FROM item_quantities ipq
JOIN products it ON ipq.item_id = it.product_id
WHERE ipq.total_quantity > 500
ORDER BY ipq.top_packaging_name, it.name;

  SELECT ol.line_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity AS order_quantity, io.location_id, io.aisle, io.position, io.available_quantity,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ol.product_id ORDER BY ol.line_id) AS order_line_seq,
         SUM(ol.quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY ol.product_id ORDER BY ol.line_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_order_qty
  FROM order_lines ol
  LEFT JOIN inventory_ordered io ON ol.product_id = io.product_id

pick_final AS (
  SELECT pa.line_id, pa.product_id, pa.location_id, pa.aisle, pa.position,
         CASE
           WHEN pa.available_quantity > 0 THEN 
             CASE
               WHEN pa.cumulative_order_qty - COALESCE(LAG(pa.cumulative_order_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY pa.product_id ORDER BY pa.line_id), 0) > pa.available_quantity THEN pa.available_quantity
               ELSE pa.cumulative_order_qty - COALESCE(LAG(pa.cumulative_order_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY pa.product_id ORDER BY pa.line_id), 0)
             END
           ELSE 0
         END AS quantity_to_pick
  FROM pick_plan pa
  WHERE pa.available_quantity > 0
)

SELECT line_id, product_id, aisle, position, SUM(quantity_to_pick) AS quantity_to_pick
FROM pick_final
WHERE quantity_to_pick > 0
GROUP BY line_id, product_id, aisle, position
ORDER BY line_id, product_id, aisle, position

  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY product_id

assigned_picks AS (
  SELECT
    io.product_id,
    io.location_id,
    io.aisle,
    io.position,
    io.inv_qty,
    op.total_qty,
    SUM(io.inv_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY io.product_id ORDER BY io.purchased, io.inv_qty ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total
  FROM inventory_ordered io
  JOIN order_product_totals op ON io.product_id = op.product_id
),

  SELECT
    product_id,
    aisle,
    position,
    CASE 
      WHEN running_total > total_qty 
        THEN inv_qty - (running_total - total_qty)
      ELSE inv_qty
    END AS pick_qty
  FROM assigned_picks
  WHERE running_total - inv_qty < total_qty
    AND CASE 
      WHEN running_total > total_qty 
        THEN inv_qty - (running_total - total_qty)
      ELSE inv_qty
    END > 0

FROM final_picks
GROUP BY product_id, aisle, position

WITH
-- Extract starting inventory as sum of qty in inventory for Dec 2018 per product
starting_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.product_id, SUM(i.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
    WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', p.purchased) = '2018-12'
    GROUP BY i.product_id
),

-- Minimum inventory per product
minimum_inventory AS (
    SELECT product_id, qty_minimum
    FROM product_minimums
),

-- Aggregate monthly purchases in 2019 per product
monthly_purchases AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           CAST(strftime('%m', purchased) AS INTEGER) AS month,
           SUM(qty) AS purchase_qty
    FROM purchases
    WHERE strftime('%Y', purchased) = '2019'
    GROUP BY product_id, month
),

-- Recursive inventory calculation month by month for 2019
inventory_2019 AS (
    -- Anchor: month = 1 (January 2019)
    SELECT 
        si.product_id,
        2019 AS year,
        1 AS month,
        CASE WHEN si.total_qty < pm.qty_minimum THEN pm.qty_minimum ELSE si.total_qty END AS start_inventory,
        CASE WHEN si.total_qty < pm.qty_minimum THEN pm.qty_minimum + COALESCE(mp.purchase_qty, 0) ELSE si.total_qty + COALESCE(mp.purchase_qty, 0) END AS end_inventory,
        pm.qty_minimum
    FROM starting_inventory si
    JOIN minimum_inventory pm ON si.product_id = pm.product_id
    LEFT JOIN monthly_purchases mp ON si.product_id = mp.product_id AND mp.month = 1

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive step for months 2 to 12
    SELECT
        inv.product_id,
        2019 AS year,
        inv.month + 1 AS month,
        CASE WHEN inv.end_inventory < inv.qty_minimum THEN inv.qty_minimum ELSE inv.end_inventory END AS start_inventory,
        CASE WHEN inv.end_inventory < inv.qty_minimum THEN inv.qty_minimum + COALESCE(mp.purchase_qty, 0) ELSE inv.end_inventory + COALESCE(mp.purchase_qty, 0) END AS end_inventory,
        inv.qty_minimum
    FROM inventory_2019 inv
    LEFT JOIN monthly_purchases mp ON inv.product_id = mp.product_id AND mp.month = inv.month + 1
    WHERE inv.month < 12
)

SELECT product_id, month,
       ABS(end_inventory - qty_minimum) AS abs_difference
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, month, end_inventory, qty_minimum,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY ABS(end_inventory - qty_minimum)) AS rnk
    FROM inventory_2019
)
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY product_id;

    AND c.insert_date BETWEEN '2021-07-01' AND '2021-07-31'

         DATE(date, '-' || ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city_name ORDER BY date) || ' day') AS grp

  SELECT city_name, MIN(date) AS start_date, MAX(date) AS end_date, COUNT(*) AS length
  FROM ranked_dates

  FROM groups

  GROUP BY s.year
)

  year,
  sales_before,
  sales_after,
  ROUND((CAST(sales_after AS FLOAT) - sales_before) / NULLIF(sales_before, 0) * 100, 2) AS pct_change
FROM weekly_sales_lag_lead

WITH monthly_inserts AS (

    STRFTIME('%Y', inserted_at) AS year,
    STRFTIME('%m', inserted_at) AS month,

  FROM cities
  WHERE inserted_at >= '2021-04-01' AND inserted_at < '2023-07-01'

  GROUP BY year, month
),
running_totals AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    month,
    cities_added,
    SUM(cities_added) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total
  FROM monthly_inserts
),
growth_calc AS (
  SELECT
    current.year,
    current.month,
    current.cities_added,
    current.running_total,

    -- Monthly YoY Growth %
    CASE 
      WHEN prev_year.cities_added IS NOT NULL THEN 
        ROUND(100.0 * (current.cities_added - prev_year.cities_added) / prev_year.cities_added, 2)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS monthly_yoy_growth_pct,

    -- Running Total YoY Growth %
    CASE
      WHEN prev_year.running_total IS NOT NULL THEN
        ROUND(100.0 * (current.running_total - prev_year.running_total) / prev_year.running_total, 2)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS running_total_yoy_growth_pct

  FROM running_totals current
  LEFT JOIN running_totals prev_year
    ON current.month = prev_year.month
   AND CAST(current.year AS INTEGER) = CAST(prev_year.year AS INTEGER) + 1
)

  year,
  month,
  cities_added,
  running_total,
  monthly_yoy_growth_pct,
  running_total_yoy_growth_pct
FROM growth_calc
WHERE year IN ('2022', '2023')
ORDER BY month, year;

),

  SELECT su.city, su.prod_id,

  FROM filtered_products fp

WITH
-- Get country_id for United States
us_country_id AS (
  SELECT country_id FROM countries WHERE country_name = 'United States' LIMIT 1
),

-- Filter for US customers and sales in Q4 of 2019 and 2020, no promotions
us_sales_q4 AS (
  SELECT
    c.cust_city AS city,
    s.prod_id,
    s.amount_sold,
    t.calendar_year,
    t.calendar_quarter_desc
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN us_country_id u ON c.country_id = u.country_id
  WHERE s.promo_id = 0
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND t.calendar_quarter_desc IN ('Q4 2019', 'Q4 2020')
),

-- Sum sales by city and quarter
city_q4_sales AS (
  SELECT
    city,
    calendar_quarter_desc AS quarter,
    SUM(amount_sold) AS total_sales
  FROM us_sales_q4
  GROUP BY city, quarter
),

-- Filter cities where sales rose at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020
cities_increase_20 AS (
  SELECT
    city
  FROM city_q4_sales
  GROUP BY city
  HAVING
    SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q4 2020' THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) >=
    1.2 * SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q4 2019' THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END)
),

-- Calculate sales by product in these cities across the two quarters
product_sales AS (
  SELECT
    prod_id,
    calendar_quarter_desc AS quarter,
    SUM(amount_sold) AS sales
  FROM us_sales_q4
  WHERE city IN (SELECT city FROM cities_increase_20)
  GROUP BY prod_id, quarter
),

-- Overall sales by product across quarters
product_total_sales AS (
  SELECT
    prod_id,
    SUM(sales) AS total_sales
  FROM product_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id
),

-- Rank products by total sales and keep top 20%
ranked_products AS (
  SELECT
    prod_id,
    total_sales,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS quintile
  FROM product_total_sales
),

top_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id
  FROM ranked_products
  WHERE quintile = 1
),

-- Total sales in the cities by quarter
total_sales_q4 AS (
  SELECT
    quarter,
    SUM(sales) AS total_sales
  FROM product_sales
  GROUP BY quarter
),

-- Sales of top products by quarter
 top_product_sales AS (
  SELECT
    prod_id,
    quarter,
    sales
  FROM product_sales
  WHERE prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top_products)
),

-- Calculate share and share change from 2019 to 2020
share_changes AS (
  SELECT
    tps.prod_id,
    COALESCE(tps_2019.sales, 0) AS sales_2019,
    COALESCE(tps_2020.sales, 0) AS sales_2020,
    ts_2019.total_sales AS total_2019,
    ts_2020.total_sales AS total_2020,
    CASE WHEN ts_2019.total_sales > 0 THEN tps_2019.sales / ts_2019.total_sales ELSE 0 END AS share_2019,
    CASE WHEN ts_2020.total_sales > 0 THEN tps_2020.sales / ts_2020.total_sales ELSE 0 END AS share_2020,
    CASE WHEN ts_2019.total_sales > 0 AND ts_2020.total_sales > 0 THEN
      (tps_2020.sales / ts_2020.total_sales) - (tps_2019.sales / ts_2019.total_sales)
      ELSE 0 END AS share_change
  FROM top_product_sales tps
  LEFT JOIN product_sales tps_2019 ON tps.prod_id = tps_2019.prod_id AND tps_2019.quarter = 'Q4 2019'
  LEFT JOIN product_sales tps_2020 ON tps.prod_id = tps_2020.prod_id AND tps_2020.quarter = 'Q4 2020'
  LEFT JOIN total_sales_q4 ts_2019 ON ts_2019.quarter = 'Q4 2019'
  LEFT JOIN total_sales_q4 ts_2020 ON ts_2020.quarter = 'Q4 2020'
  GROUP BY tps.prod_id, tps_2019.sales, tps_2020.sales, ts_2019.total_sales, ts_2020.total_sales
)

SELECT
  prod_id AS product_id,
  share_2019,
  share_2020,
  share_change
FROM share_changes
ORDER BY share_change DESC
LIMIT 1000;

  CASE 
    WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
    WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
    WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
    WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
    ELSE 'others'
  END AS age_category,
  COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM mst_users
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY age_category;

WITH age_calculated AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN birth_date IS NOT NULL THEN CAST((strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', birth_date)) AS INTEGER)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS age
  FROM mst_users
), age_category AS (
  SELECT
    CASE 
      WHEN age BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
      WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
      WHEN age BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
      WHEN age BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
      ELSE 'others'
    END AS age_group
  FROM age_calculated
)
SELECT age_group, COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM age_category
GROUP BY age_group
ORDER BY age_group;

WITH MatchResults AS (
  SELECT
    league_id,
    season,
    home_team_api_id AS team_id,
    CASE
      WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 3
      WHEN home_team_goal = away_team_goal THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS points
  FROM Match
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    league_id,
    season,
    away_team_api_id AS team_id,
    CASE
      WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 3
      WHEN away_team_goal = home_team_goal THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS points
  FROM Match
),

TeamPoints AS (
  SELECT
    league_id,
    season,
    team_id,
    SUM(points) AS total_points
  FROM MatchResults
  GROUP BY league_id, season, team_id
),

MaxPointsPerSeason AS (
  SELECT
    league_id,
    season,
    MAX(total_points) AS max_points
  FROM TeamPoints
  GROUP BY league_id, season
),

ChampionTeams AS (
  SELECT
    tp.league_id,
    tp.season,
    tp.team_id,
    tp.total_points
  FROM TeamPoints tp
  JOIN MaxPointsPerSeason mps ON tp.league_id = mps.league_id AND tp.season = mps.season AND tp.total_points = mps.max_points
),

ChampionDetails AS (
  SELECT
    ct.season,
    t.team_long_name AS champion_team_name,
    l.name AS league_name,
    c.name AS country_name,
    ct.total_points
  FROM ChampionTeams ct
  JOIN Team t ON ct.team_id = t.team_api_id
  JOIN League l ON ct.league_id = l.id
  JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
)

SELECT * FROM ChampionDetails
ORDER BY season, country_name, league_name, champion_team_name
;

WITH Points AS (
  SELECT
    m.season,
    m.league_id,
    m.country_id,
    m.home_team_api_id AS team_id,
    CASE
      WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
      WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS points
  FROM Match m
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    m.season,
    m.league_id,
    m.country_id,
    m.away_team_api_id AS team_id,
    CASE
      WHEN m.home_team_goal < m.away_team_goal THEN 3
      WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS points
  FROM Match m
),
TotalPoints AS (
  SELECT
    season,
    league_id,
    country_id,
    team_id,
    SUM(points) AS total_points
  FROM Points
  GROUP BY season, league_id, country_id, team_id
),
RankedTeams AS (
  SELECT
    tp.*,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY season, league_id, country_id ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS rank
  FROM TotalPoints tp
)
SELECT
  t.team_long_name AS champion_team,
  l.name AS league,
  c.name AS country,
  rt.total_points
FROM RankedTeams rt
JOIN Team t ON rt.team_id = t.team_api_id
JOIN League l ON rt.league_id = l.id
JOIN Country c ON rt.country_id = c.id
WHERE rt.rank = 1
ORDER BY rt.season, c.name, l.name;

WITH OrderedCities AS (
  SELECT
    geolocation_state,
    geolocation_city,
    geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
    geolocation_lat,
    geolocation_lng,
    LAG(geolocation_lat) OVER (
      ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng
    ) AS prev_lat,
    LAG(geolocation_lng) OVER (
      ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng
    ) AS prev_lng,
    LAG(geolocation_city) OVER (
      ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng
    ) AS prev_city,
    LAG(geolocation_state) OVER (
      ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng
    ) AS prev_state
  FROM olist_geolocation
),
Distances AS (
  SELECT
    geolocation_state,
    geolocation_city,
    prev_state,
    prev_city,
    -- Convert degrees to radians: degrees * PI()/180
    6371 * ACOS(
      COS(RADIANS(prev_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(geolocation_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(geolocation_lng) - RADIANS(prev_lng))
      + SIN(RADIANS(prev_lat)) * SIN(RADIANS(geolocation_lat))
    ) AS distance_km
  FROM OrderedCities
  WHERE prev_lat IS NOT NULL AND prev_lng IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  prev_state AS state1,
  prev_city AS city1,
  geolocation_state AS state2,
  geolocation_city AS city2,
  distance_km
FROM Distances
ORDER BY distance_km DESC
LIMIT 1;

    date(c.insert_date) AS inserted_city_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.country_code_2 ORDER BY date(c.insert_date)) AS rn
  FROM cities c

),

),

)

FROM ConsecutiveStreaks
WHERE streak_length = (
  SELECT MAX(streak_length) FROM ConsecutiveStreaks
)
ORDER BY country_code;

WITH CityAorHyphen AS (
  SELECT city_id
  FROM city
  WHERE city LIKE 'A%' OR city LIKE '%-%'
),
RentalHoursByCategory AS (
  SELECT fc.category_id,
         SUM(julianday(r.return_date) - julianday(r.rental_date)) AS total_rental_hours
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id
  JOIN store s ON i.store_id = s.store_id
  JOIN address a ON s.address_id = a.address_id
  WHERE a.city_id IN (SELECT city_id FROM CityAorHyphen)
  GROUP BY fc.category_id
),
MaxRentalCategory AS (
  SELECT category_id
  FROM RentalHoursByCategory
  ORDER BY total_rental_hours DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT c.name AS film_category_with_highest_rental_hours
FROM category c
JOIN MaxRentalCategory mrc ON c.category_id = mrc.category_id;

WITH monthly_net AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    STRFTIME('%Y-%m-01', txn_date) AS month_start,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS net_amount
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, month_start
),
closing_balance AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    month_start,
    SUM(net_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS closing_balance
  FROM monthly_net
),
latest_growth AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    month_start,
    closing_balance,
    LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) AS prev_balance,
    CASE 
      WHEN LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) = 0 OR LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) IS NULL
        THEN closing_balance * 100
      ELSE
        (closing_balance - LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start)) * 100.0 / LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start)
    END AS growth_rate
  FROM closing_balance
),
most_recent_month AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    growth_rate
  FROM (
    SELECT customer_id, growth_rate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start DESC) AS rank
    FROM latest_growth
  )
  WHERE rank = 1
)
SELECT
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS pct_customers_growth_above_5
FROM most_recent_month;

WITH monthly_net AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m-01', txn_date) AS month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS net_amount
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, month
),
monthly_balance AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        month,
        SUM(net_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS closing_balance
    FROM monthly_net
),
recent_growth AS (
    SELECT
        a.customer_id,
        a.month,
        a.closing_balance AS recent_balance,
        COALESCE(b.closing_balance, 0) AS previous_balance,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(b.closing_balance, 0) = 0 THEN a.closing_balance * 100
            ELSE (a.closing_balance - COALESCE(b.closing_balance, 0)) * 100.0 / COALESCE(b.closing_balance, 1)
        END AS growth_rate
    FROM monthly_balance a
    LEFT JOIN monthly_balance b ON a.customer_id = b.customer_id AND a.month = strftime('%Y-%m-01', date(b.month, '+1 month'))
    WHERE a.month = (SELECT MAX(month) FROM monthly_balance WHERE customer_id = a.customer_id)
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage_customers_above_5pct_growth
FROM recent_growth;
