WITH driver_points_per_year AS (
  SELECT
    d.year,
    r.driver_id,
    SUM(r.points) AS total_points
  FROM results r
  JOIN races ra ON r.race_id = ra.race_id
  JOIN drivers d ON r.driver_id = d.driver_id
  GROUP BY d.year, r.driver_id
), max_driver_points AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    MAX(total_points) AS max_points
  FROM driver_points_per_year
  GROUP BY year
), top_drivers AS (
  SELECT
    dp.year,
    dp.driver_id,
    dp.total_points
  FROM driver_points_per_year dp
  JOIN max_driver_points mdp ON dp.year = mdp.year AND dp.total_points = mdp.max_points
), constructor_points_per_year AS (
  SELECT
    ra.year,
    r.constructor_id,
    SUM(r.points) AS total_points
  FROM results r
  JOIN races ra ON r.race_id = ra.race_id
  GROUP BY ra.year, r.constructor_id
), max_constructor_points AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    MAX(total_points) AS max_points
  FROM constructor_points_per_year
  GROUP BY year
), top_constructors AS (
  SELECT
    cp.year,
    cp.constructor_id,
    cp.total_points
  FROM constructor_points_per_year cp
  JOIN max_constructor_points mcp ON cp.year = mcp.year AND cp.total_points = mcp.max_points
)

SELECT 
  td.year,
  dr.forename || ' ' || dr.surname AS driver_name,
  td.total_points AS driver_points,
  co.name AS constructor_name,
  tc.total_points AS constructor_points
FROM top_drivers td
JOIN drivers dr ON td.driver_id = dr.driver_id
JOIN top_constructors tc ON td.year = tc.year
JOIN constructors co ON tc.constructor_id = co.constructor_id
ORDER BY td.year;

WITH ActorYears AS (
    SELECT
        c.PID,
        CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) AS year
    FROM M_Cast c
    JOIN Movie m ON c.MID = m.MID
    WHERE m.year IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY c.PID, m.year
),
YearGaps AS (
    SELECT
        PID,
        year,
        LEAD(year) OVER (PARTITION BY PID ORDER BY year) AS next_year
    FROM ActorYears
),
ActorsWithLongGap AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        PID
    FROM YearGaps
    WHERE next_year IS NOT NULL AND next_year - year > 3
),
ActorsActiveSpan AS (
    SELECT
        PID,
        MIN(year) AS first_year,
        MAX(year) AS last_year
    FROM ActorYears
    GROUP BY PID
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM ActorsActiveSpan
WHERE PID NOT IN (SELECT PID FROM ActorsWithLongGap);

            COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) AS extra_runs
        FROM ball_by_ball b
        LEFT JOIN batsman_scored br
            ON b.match_id = br.match_id AND b.ball_id = br.ball_id AND b.innings_no = br.innings_no
        LEFT JOIN extra_runs er
            ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
    ) subquery

),

WITH sales_data AS (

        strftime('%Y-%m', o.ordered) AS year_month,
        p.id AS productid,
        SUM(ol.amount) AS monthly_sales
    FROM
        orders o
    JOIN orderlines ol ON o.id = ol.order_id
    JOIN products p ON ol.product_id = p.id
    WHERE
        o.ordered >= '2016-01-01' AND o.ordered < '2018-01-01'
    GROUP BY
        year_month, p.id
), numbered_months AS (
    SELECT
        year_month,
        productid,
        monthly_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY productid ORDER BY year_month) AS month_index
    FROM sales_data
), cma_calc AS (
    SELECT
        a.year_month,
        a.productid,
        a.monthly_sales,
        AVG(b.monthly_sales) AS window1_avg,
        AVG(c.monthly_sales) AS window2_avg
    FROM numbered_months a
    LEFT JOIN numbered_months b ON a.productid = b.productid AND b.month_index BETWEEN a.month_index - 5 AND a.month_index + 6
    LEFT JOIN numbered_months c ON a.productid = c.productid AND c.month_index BETWEEN a.month_index - 6 AND a.month_index + 5
    WHERE a.month_index BETWEEN 7 AND 30
    GROUP BY a.productid, a.year_month, a.monthly_sales, a.month_index
), cma_final AS (
    SELECT
        year_month,
        productid,
        monthly_sales,
        (window1_avg + window2_avg) / 2.0 AS cma
    FROM cma_calc
), ratio_calc AS (
    SELECT
        year_month,
        productid,
        monthly_sales / cma AS sales_to_cma_ratio
    FROM cma_final
    WHERE cma > 0
), filtered_2017 AS (
    SELECT * FROM ratio_calc
    WHERE year_month LIKE '2017%'
)

WITH city_coords AS (
    SELECT airport_code, city, 
        CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(coordinates AS TEXT), 1, 3) AS FLOAT) AS longitude,
        CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(coordinates AS TEXT), 4, 3) AS FLOAT) AS latitude
    FROM airports_data
), city_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN dep.city < arr.city THEN dep.city ELSE arr.city END AS city1,
        CASE WHEN dep.city < arr.city THEN arr.city ELSE dep.city END AS city2,
        AVG(
            2 * 6371 * ASIN(
                SQRT(
                    POWER(SIN((RADIANS(arr.latitude) - RADIANS(dep.latitude)) / 2), 2) +
                    COS(RADIANS(dep.latitude)) * COS(RADIANS(arr.latitude)) * POWER(SIN((RADIANS(arr.longitude) - RADIANS(dep.longitude)) / 2), 2)
                )
            )
        ) AS avg_distance
    FROM flights f
    JOIN city_coords dep ON f.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
    JOIN city_coords arr ON f.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
    GROUP BY city1, city2
), buckets AS (
    SELECT city1, city2, avg_distance,
    CASE
        WHEN avg_distance < 1000 THEN 0
        WHEN avg_distance < 2000 THEN 1000
        WHEN avg_distance < 3000 THEN 2000
        WHEN avg_distance < 4000 THEN 3000
        WHEN avg_distance < 5000 THEN 4000
        WHEN avg_distance < 6000 THEN 5000
        ELSE 6000
    END AS distance_range
    FROM city_pairs
), bucket_counts AS (
    SELECT distance_range, COUNT(*) AS pair_count
    FROM buckets
    GROUP BY distance_range
)
SELECT pair_count
FROM bucket_counts
WHERE pair_count = (
    SELECT MIN(pair_count) FROM bucket_counts
)
LIMIT 1000
;

        p.driver_id AS overtaken_driver_id

    WHERE c.curr_position < p.prev_position
),

    SELECT
        o.race_id,
        o.lap,
        o.overtaking_driver_id,
        o.overtaken_driver_id,
        CASE
            WHEN r.driver_id IS NOT NULL AND r.lap = o.lap THEN 'R'
            WHEN pe.race_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'P'
            WHEN px.race_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'P'
            WHEN o.lap = 1
                 AND ABS(qo1.position - qo2.position) <= 2 THEN 'S'
            ELSE 'T'
        END AS overtake_type
    FROM overtakes o
    LEFT JOIN retirements r ON r.race_id = o.race_id AND r.driver_id = o.overtaken_driver_id
    LEFT JOIN pit_stops pe ON pe.race_id = o.race_id AND pe.driver_id = o.overtaken_driver_id AND pe.lap = o.lap
    LEFT JOIN pit_stops px ON px.race_id = o.race_id AND px.driver_id = o.overtaken_driver_id AND px.lap = o.lap - 1
    LEFT JOIN qualifying qo1 ON qo1.race_id = o.race_id AND qo1.driver_id = o.overtaking_driver_id
    LEFT JOIN qualifying qo2 ON qo2.race_id = o.race_id AND qo2.driver_id = o.overtaken_driver_id
    WHERE o.race_id IN (SELECT race_id FROM sample_race)
),

)

WITH PitStopsByRaceLap AS (
  SELECT race_id, lap, driver_id FROM pit_stops
),
RetirementsByRaceLap AS (
  SELECT race_id, lap, driver_id FROM retirements WHERE lap IS NOT NULL
),
StartPositions AS (
  SELECT q.race_id, q.driver_id, q.position AS grid
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN races r ON q.race_id = r.race_id
  WHERE q.position IS NOT NULL
),
DriverPositions AS (
  SELECT race_id, lap, driver_id, position FROM lap_positions
),
Overtakes AS (
  -- Identify instances when a driver was not behind another driver previous lap but is behind on current lap
  SELECT 
    curr.race_id, curr.lap, curr.driver_id AS overtaking_driver,
    other.driver_id AS overtaken_driver
  FROM DriverPositions curr
  JOIN DriverPositions prev_curr ON curr.race_id = prev_curr.race_id AND curr.lap = prev_curr.lap + 1 AND curr.driver_id = prev_curr.driver_id
  JOIN DriverPositions other ON curr.race_id = other.race_id AND curr.lap = other.lap AND curr.position > other.position
  JOIN DriverPositions prev_other ON prev_other.race_id = other.race_id AND prev_other.lap = other.lap - 1 AND prev_other.driver_id = other.driver_id
  JOIN DriverPositions prev_curr2 ON prev_curr2.race_id = curr.race_id AND prev_curr2.lap = curr.lap - 1 AND prev_curr2.driver_id = curr.driver_id
  WHERE prev_curr2.position <= prev_other.position
),
OvertakeLabels AS (
  SELECT
    o.race_id, o.lap, o.overtaking_driver, o.overtaken_driver,
    CASE
      WHEN r.driver_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'R'
      WHEN (p_entry.driver_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'P'
      WHEN (p_exit.driver_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'P'
      WHEN o.lap = 1 AND ABS(sp1.grid - sp2.grid) <= 2 THEN 'S'
      ELSE 'T'
    END AS overtake_type
  FROM Overtakes o
  LEFT JOIN RetirementsByRaceLap r ON o.race_id = r.race_id AND o.lap = r.lap AND o.overtaken_driver = r.driver_id
  LEFT JOIN PitStopsByRaceLap p_entry ON o.race_id = p_entry.race_id AND o.lap = p_entry.lap AND o.overtaken_driver = p_entry.driver_id
  LEFT JOIN PitStopsByRaceLap p_exit ON o.race_id = p_exit.race_id AND o.lap - 1 = p_exit.lap AND o.overtaken_driver = p_exit.driver_id
  LEFT JOIN StartPositions sp1 ON o.race_id = sp1.race_id AND o.overtaking_driver = sp1.driver_id
  LEFT JOIN StartPositions sp2 ON o.race_id = sp2.race_id AND o.overtaken_driver = sp2.driver_id
)
SELECT overtake_type, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM OvertakeLabels
GROUP BY overtake_type
ORDER BY overtake_type;

MaxOverWithBowler AS (
    SELECT
        mor.match_id,
        mor.innings_no,
        mor.over_id,
        mor.total_runs,
        bb.bowler
    FROM MaxOverRuns mor
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb 
        ON bb.match_id = mor.match_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = mor.innings_no 
        AND bb.over_id = mor.over_id
    GROUP BY mor.match_id, mor.innings_no, mor.over_id, mor.total_runs, bb.bowler
)
SELECT
    AVG(total_runs) AS avg_highest_over_runs
FROM
    MaxOverWithBowler;
